Added central src/lib/session.ts. performSignOut() deduplicates concurrent calls and runs all registerSignOutTask() cleanups, then resets analytics, clears RevenueCat identity, React Query cache, chat cache, pending + pinned scans and the cached profile before supabase.auth.signOut — fixes data bleeding between accounts on a shared device. Also exposes refreshSessionOnce() and recoverSessionOrSignOut().

apiFetch gained a 30s AbortController timeout (could previously hang forever), merges an external signal, refreshes the session once and retries on 401, and only fire-and-forget signs out when the session is truly unrecoverable; avoids deadlock when the failing request runs inside a sign-out task. 403 no longer signs out.

streamPost accepts an AbortSignal, arms a 60s stall watchdog re-armed on each onprogress (silently-dead streams now reject), waits for the body before rejecting on HTTP error, and fire-and-forget recovers the session on 401 instead of deadlocking.
Rewritten on React Query (queryKey ['limits'], staleTime 60s); a network failure keeps the last known plan instead of silently reverting Pro users to free.

AccountGate reads a per-user cached /profile from AsyncStorage to render the app instantly on cold start, then refreshes in the background; on error with a cached profile the user is let in with stale data instead of being blocked on a spinner.

Cold-start notification taps handled via getLastNotificationResponseAsync with a handledResponseIds guard so the tap routes correctly and never double-fires; the Expo push token is stored and DELETEd from the backend on sign-out (registerSignOutTask) so a signed-out user stops receiving pushes.

Streaming answer is aborted via AbortController when leaving the screen (deliberate aborts suppressed), and tokens are buffered ~80ms before flushing to state to stop the per-token re-render storm during fast generation.

Upload switched from base64 to ArrayBuffer to Supabase (OOM on multi-MB PDFs) to native FileSystem.uploadAsync streaming straight from disk; added a 20MB client guard with a localized scanApi.fileTooLarge message (cs/ru/uk/en).

removePendingScanById/clearPendingScans now delete the local cached attachment files (only URIs under FileSystem.cacheDirectory) so processed scans stop accumulating on disk; added clearPinnedScans() for the sign-out cleanup path.

Supabase auth session moved from plain AsyncStorage to an encrypted expo-secure-store adapter (iOS Keychain / Android Keystore) with 1800-byte chunking for the iOS 2KB item cap and a one-time transparent migration from AsyncStorage so existing users are not signed out. Requires native rebuild.

Replaced fragmented <Text selectable> (only one sentence could be selected, awkward native copy menu) with explicit per-block copy buttons via expo-clipboard: summary, what-to-do steps, deadline cards, info blocks and assistant chat answers each copy the whole block with haptic + 1.5s confirmation; added a copy icon and chat.copy/chat.copied strings. Requires native rebuild.

OAMP tracking card now shows a dedicated first-check label while last_checked_at is null: 'Статус визы — проверяем' in ru, with matching cs/uk/en translations (tracking.types.oamp_status.checkingTitle = kontrolujeme/проверяем/перевіряємо/checking); completed statuses still use the backend status title such as 'В обработке'.

Free-user PDF picker Pro CTA is now an active primary button with accessibility role, pressed state, haptic feedback, and 'Перейти на Pro · до 10 страниц' copy. Opening paywall now temporarily hides the PDF picker (visible only when !showPaywall) to avoid stacked Modal issues, and after purchase the picker keeps the selected PDF while refreshing available page slots from /limits.

Settled on a single copy mechanism (variant A): removed the duplicate long-press -> ActionSheet copy path (onCopyRequest prop chain through ResultCard/DeadlineReminderRow/MessageBubble, openCopySheet/copySelectedText, copySheetText/copyToastVisible state, the ActionSheet + copyToast render, resultCardToPlainText/deadlineToPlainText helpers, ActionSheet import, copyToast styles). Explicit per-block CopyButton icons remain. Also restored the deadline card background that disappeared after the merge — DeadlineReminderRow is wrapped in a View styled with blueSoft fill + blueMid border (was previously a LinearGradient) so the СРОКИ/ЗАДАЧА block reads as a card again.

Re-enabled native text selection on result-card and chat content. First tried the <Text selectable> prop but on iOS it is unreliable inside FlatList/ScrollView (long-press is swallowed by the scroll responder), so switched to the existing TextInput-backed SelectableText component (editable=false on iOS, caretHidden, contextMenuHidden=false) for resultTitle, summary, action lines, deadline date + address, info-block text, and the assistant/user message bubble. docKind/docFrom header captions stay plain Text to avoid TextInput layout drift. User now has both: CopyButton icon for whole-block copy and reliable long-press selection for arbitrary spans.

CopyButton gained an optional title prop that is prepended (title + newline + body) when copying a whole block, so the clipboard text now carries the block name: summary -> document title, actions -> 'Co s tim udelat', each deadline -> its deadline-type label, info blocks (where to go / documents / penalty / tips) -> their section title. Also made the assistant chat-message CopyButton icon-only (compact) — dropped the 'Copy' text label so only the icon shows; result-card buttons were already compact.

Telegram-style auto-growing message input. composerPill switched from fixed height:48 to minHeight:48 + paddingVertical:6 + alignItems:flex-end so the send button hugs the bottom as the field grows; composerInput marginBottom:7 keeps the single-line state vertically centered against the 36px send button. Removed returnKeyType=send/onSubmitEditing so Return inserts a newline (send is button-only), matching Telegram mobile. First attempt used a JS-controlled height via onContentSizeChange, but on iOS the inserted newline was clipped before the height state updated (looked like Enter did nothing); replaced with native multiline auto-grow — composerInput uses minHeight/maxHeight (22..120) and the TextInput has submitBehavior=newline, so Return reliably adds a line, the field grows to ~6 lines, then scrolls internally.

Two composer fixes. (1) Question counter (n/10) now vertically centered via alignSelf:center, overriding the pill's flex-end. (2) Working Stop button: the square shown during streaming was disabled (disabled || streaming) so it did nothing. SendButton now treats chat streaming (streaming && !muted) as stoppable — accent background, enabled, onPress -> new onStop handler; a still-processing scan (muted) keeps the non-interactive muted square. handleStopStreaming aborts streamAbortRef then refreshes /limits (backend may have counted the question before cancel). ask() catch now keeps the partial answer on a deliberate abort and only drops the bubble if empty. Added chat.stop string (cs/ru/uk/en).

Readability pass. Chat message bubbles were ~13.5px and unbounded width (the maxWidth:84% messageWrap style was dead/unused after the merge, so bubbles spanned nearly full width). Now bubbleText is 16/21 (callout) and the bubble style caps at maxWidth:82%; removed the unused messageWrap/userMessageWrap/assistantMessageWrap styles. Help guides bumped to match: contentText 15 -> 16/22, warningText 13 -> 15/21 (overridden per-style, shared typeStyles tokens untouched). Chose 16 over 17 to stay just above the 15px result-card subhead without inverting hierarchy.

Finished the readability bump that fe-fix-73 missed: result-card body text was still small, so raised resultSummary and resultLine from rowSecondary(15) to 16/22, infoBlockText (where-to-go/documents/penalty/tip) from rowMeta(13) to 16/22, and deadline address from 13 to 15/21 — now consistent with the 16px chat bubbles. Also added per-block copy to Help guides: new GuideCopyButton (expo-clipboard + haptic + check confirmation, icon-only) placed on every guide section — text/steps/checklist get a blockHeader row (title left, copy right) and the warning card gets a top-aligned copy button. blockPlainText() builds the clipboard string as title + body/numbered-steps/bulleted-checklist. Pro-gated blurred sections intentionally get no copy button.

Unified guide section headers (variant B). After body text went to 16, headers were inconsistent and some smaller than body: text-section title used the eyebrow style (caption2 = 11px uppercase blue) and warningTitle used rowMeta (13px). Switched the text-section title to contentTitle (headline 17 bold, sentence case) to match steps/checklist, and bumped warningTitle from rowMeta(13) to headline(17) keeping the amber colour. All section headers are now 17 bold, clearly above the 16px body. Removed the now-unused eyebrow style.

Root cause of empty document list: backend wraps GET /scans in ScanListResponse { scans, plan, archive_limit, hidden_count } for Free-tier archive gating; frontend still called apiFetch<ScanListItem[]> and received the whole envelope object, so scans state was set to {} and forEach crashed. Wrapped app in PersistQueryClientProvider (@tanstack/react-query-persist-client + query-async-storage-persister 5.101.0) so the RQ cache survives cold starts and is readable offline. Note: RQ only backs visa-status trackings (Deadlines screen) and the Pro entitlement — scans/deadlines still fetch manually via useState/useEffect and are NOT covered (would need AsyncStorage write-through or migration to useQuery, see backlog). queryClient.ts: AsyncStorage persister (key jasne_rq_cache_v1, 1s throttle), 24h maxAge, app-version buster via Application.nativeApplicationVersion (discards stale-shaped cache on new build), queries gcTime bumped to 24h so restored entries survive the persistence window. session.ts signOutOnce(): added persister.removeClient() next to queryClient.clear() so the next user on the device can't restore the previous account's trackings/entitlement from disk. jest.setup.js: added official AsyncStorage jest mock (queryClient.ts now imports it transitively). All 196 tests pass.
